Cowork Local Viewer

Session —
🔒 Read-only, 100% local. This page runs offline in your browser: nothing is sent anywhere, nothing on your disk is modified. It reads what you drop and lets you view and export it.
Drop a local_… folder and its local_….json here (select both in the Finder, drop them together)
You can drop several sessions at once. Dropping works anywhere on the page, and drops add up.
Projects: drop spaces.json (in Application Support/Claude/) to see which project each session belongs to.
Reopen an archive: drop a downloaded ZIP here (or its unzipped folder): same view, reading/full mode, day filter, re-export.
Index of all sessions: drop only the local_….json files (in the Finder, type “.json” in the search box of the sessions folder, select all, drop) then “Build the index”.

Sessions found — click to display
